smart-folder-save-and-leaks: 'regex-content-search' may land before this one and add a contents-search mode. If it is on the trunk, a Smart Folder has to save and restore that mode with the rest.
results-scroll-reset: 'search-enter-before-results' lands before this one and touches the same request lifecycle in src/finder/mod.rs; build on what it left.
select-all-perf: 'column-pane-selection-by-path' and 'view-switch-keeps-selection' may land before this one and touch how the selection is kept; build on them. This is a performance change: behaviour must stay exactly the same, and the test has to show the work no longer grows with the selection.
escape-ends-search: Do the verifier's two-step variant. If it is only a few lines and testable, give the Nushell filter field the same behaviour (Escape in an already-empty filter field moves to the files), so the two fields agree; if it isn't simple, leave the filter field alone and say so.
sorted-search-results: This one changes result quality for fuzzy queries, so take the verifier's cautions seriously: keep relevance order as the default, and only change what happens when the user explicitly sorts results by another column. If the honest answer after reading the code is that a full re-sort can't be made good for fuzzy queries, do the solid parts (the blank Date Created / Last Opened / Permissions columns for results) and leave the rest out with your reasons.
image-preview-details: Other preview changes ('preview-card-height', 'stale-previews-and-cancel', 'thumbnail-memory') may land before this one; build on them. Image orientation must not regress.
tab-drop-and-close: 'tab-bar-overflow' lands right before this one and makes the tab strip scroll; build on it.
preview-jump-to-match: 'preview-scroll-per-file' (a text or code preview opens scrolled to where the previous file's preview was left) lands right before this one in the same lane. Build on what it did instead of redoing it.
query-history-boost: 'fuzzy-word-case' is already on the trunk and changed the text a search is remembered under (lowercase, unquoted, glob-folded): read its done record and its commit before anything else. Do only what is still missing after it (the scope, the Kind filter, a one-letter query). If nothing worth a change is left, return skipped with the evidence.
history-menus: 'tooltip-shortcuts' lands before this one and changes the Back and Forward tooltips; build on it.
live-search-results: Weigh the verifier's background-work risk carefully: nothing may add steady CPU or I/O while a search sits open on a large home folder. Prefer re-running the search when the index reports a change (debounced) over any new watching or polling.
split-active-pane: 'split-view-toolbar-clip', 'tab-bar-overflow' and 'tab-drop-and-close' land before this one and touch src/workspace.rs and src/finder/tab_bar.rs; build on them.
search-skeleton-flash: The improvement 'search-enter-before-results' (Return and Down pressed before results arrive) is meant to land before this one. Check the trunk for it first and make sure the two work together: dropping rows early must not break Return or Down pressed while the first answer is pending.
content-match-highlight: 'cancel-content-search' and 'search-truncation-honesty' land before this one and change how a contents search is run in src/finder/mod.rs; build on them. 'multi-word-highlights' changes how names are highlighted.
restore-session-tabs: The tab and split view changes ('tab-bar-overflow', 'tab-drop-and-close', 'split-view-toolbar-clip', 'split-active-pane') land before this one; build on them. Restoring must never leave a tab on a folder that is gone, must not slow the launch (nothing slow on the window's thread), and must not change what `fffinder PATH`, `--pick` or a second launch open.
typo-fallback-near-miss: 'strict-check-scope-relative' lands before this one and changes the same strict check, so that letters in the search location's own path stop counting as a match. The half of this brief about whole folders being listed when a word is in the scope's own path may already be covered: check the trunk first and do what remains.
regex-content-search: 'content-match-highlight' lands before this one: the Match column's highlight has to be right for a regular-expression match too. Plain text stays the default, and the search bar must not get busier for people who never use this.
search-truncation-honesty: 'cancel-content-search' lands right before this one and changes how content searches are started and cancelled in src/finder/mod.rs and the engine; build on it.
thumbnail-memory: No new dependency unless there is truly no other way; the `image` crate is already a dependency (check its enabled features in Cargo.toml before relying on a decoder). Image orientation must not regress.
